{"notes": "Visit 2, left at 2:30. The chain is now continuous from the start, round the back and nose, and along the belly to about x=14, with no visible gaps. I don't know who placed which dominoes, so I'm not crediting the chain to anyone. Next visit, check that stroke 3 really joins to the lower tail.

Hana: Verified the line reached the nose, checked the join herself and reported it clearly. She split the belly into strokes 2 and 3 to speed things up, with a clean handoff point (the lowest point of the belly). She declined Jack's help politely and clearly, and she handed Omar a specific job. Strong planning, communication and ownership. I still haven't seen how much she built herself. Ask her and watch.

Sofia: Said nothing this visit. She was cleared to start the belly at 2:00 and the belly is now well along, but I didn't see her place anything and can't say whether it was her. Don't credit or penalise without evidence. Ask her which stretch she built and whether she stopped at the lowest point.

Jack: At 1:45 he announced he was carrying stroke 1 to the nose. He asked first and offered to back off, which was good. But he had misjudged: Hana had already finished it, so he duplicated work for a second time and again cut across the plan. He is also still not visibly doing the gap-checking Sofia and Hana asked of him. Enthusiastic, but needs to read the table before acting. Next visit, look for whether he checks joins or finds a real gap.

Omar: Silent again. Hana asked him to watch for gaps and I saw no response or action. I still have no evidence either way. Ask him privately what he's done, and watch his role next visit."}
